title: Rejection leaves state unchanged
statement: Every rejected operation must leave the affected session record, permit consumption bookkeeping, counters, and authority state unchanged.

source.reference: packet.md (rejected operations leave state unchanged); interface-bridge.md REF-002; anchors: XVE-SYS-0154, FR-019

verification_intent: Unit: snapshot-before/after assertions for every negative case in the mismatch, replay, clock, handle, and lifecycle matrices.
acceptance_criteria: For each negative case a snapshot-equality assertion covers state, consumed set, and counters.
Rejection on one session does not perturb any other session or the authority.
A failed transition never partially applies and exposes no intermediate state.
